task_title: planner의 byte admission과 실제 peak를 맞추고 원자적 동시 reservation 또는 동등 admission으로 여러 작업이 각각 free memory를 보고 동시에 초과하는 문제를 다룬다

physics_configuration.region: 3D, uniform mesh 0.05 um, 4 CPML cells on every face, Yee sampling, FP32, 12 steps, memory_mode streamed
physics_configuration.structure: smooth sphere of radius 0.3 um (width 0.08 um), permittivity 4 in air, scalar epsilon
physics_configuration.source_and_monitors: Ez point source at (-0.3, 0, 0) um, standard Gaussian pulse (0.8 um, FWHM 0.5 fs, centre 0.5 fs, amplitude 100); point probes Ez (0.3, 0, 0) and Hy (0.2, 0.1, 0); full time history; objective sum of squared signals
physics_configuration.policy: StreamedAdjointOptions(device=cuda, slab_width=8, temporal_depth=4, checkpoints=1, tile_transfers=sync) with state_storage host and disk (private scratch directory, disk_budget_bytes 4 GiB), gpu_budget_bytes 2 GiB, host_budget_bytes 16 GiB; one small warm-up run precedes the ladder so the CUDA kernels are loaded
physics_configuration.instruments: report['forward_memory'] and report['backward_memory'] of torchfdtd/memory_accounting.py: peak_torch_allocated_bytes.delta_bytes (exact allocator peak after torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats before each rung), host_bank_bytes.bytes (SlabBlockOperator bank ledger), scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes.bytes (StateStore), peak_process_rss_bytes.delta_bytes (working set, informational)
physics_configuration.registry: torchfdtd/reservation_registry.py: ReservationRegistry.acquire under one threading.Lock; StreamedSimulation forward and backward phases hold a lease on the host, gpu and disk tiers for the duration of the phase; the concurrency tests run the scatterer of tests/g5_support.py on CPU tiles with host and disk banks and a budget of 1.5 times one reservation

reference_method: the planner's own reservation (torchfdtd/streamed.py::_reservation) compared with the measured peaks of the same run; a bound check, not a physics oracle. The registry is checked by construction: two threads released together by a barrier, and a run blocked inside its first tile while a second run is admitted against the same budget

observables.name: gpu_ratio
observables.definition: gpu_reservation_bytes / max over phases of peak_torch_allocated_bytes.delta_bytes

observables.name: bank_ratio
observables.definition: host_reservation_bytes / peak host_bank_bytes for host banks; disk_reservation_bytes / peak scratch_disk_peak_file_bytes for disk banks

observables.name: gpu_margin_bytes
observables.definition: gpu_reservation_bytes minus the measured peak Torch allocated delta

observables.name: bank_margin_bytes
observables.definition: the tier reservation minus the measured peak bank bytes

observables.name: rss_ratio_informational
observables.definition: host_reservation_bytes / working-set delta of the phase; recorded, not a criterion: the working set also holds pinned staging, Torch host tensors of the caller, allocator arenas and runtime pages that the reservation does not model

acceptance_limits.rule: on every rung and for both bank tiers, gpu_ratio >= minimum_ratio and bank_ratio >= minimum_ratio, with the allocator peak flagged exact; the measured peak Torch allocated delta never exceeds the measured peak Torch reserved bytes
acceptance_limits.registry: of two simultaneous requests of 600 bytes against a 1000-byte budget exactly one is admitted and the other raises ValueError starting with 'Concurrent streamed reservation refused'; a request that overflows one tier registers nothing on any tier; a second StreamedSimulation run against a budget of 1.5 reservations is refused with that message while the first run is inside its forward phase, and is admitted after the first run finishes; a failed phase releases its lease
acceptance_limits.scope_statement: the registry guarantee is per Python process and is admission, not a quota: it does not see other processes, does not limit later allocations of an admitted run and does not replace the live free-memory checks
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: G5-03 specification: the byte admission is matched against the actual peak (ratio at least one) and concurrent admission is atomic; the margin is recorded rather than bounded above because the reservation is a documented conservative bound (docs/STREAMED_FDTD.md)

applicable_scope: RTX 3060 three-rung ladder (65,536 to 1,048,576 cells, FP32, host and disk banks, synchronous CUDA tiles) for the admission-versus-peak ratios; the concurrent-reservation registry on CPU tiles with host and disk banks; the registry guarantee is per Python process and is admission, not a quota
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent
